workflow: An insertion operation retains borrowed references to pending keys and values in shared temporary state.
User-controlled key processing re-enters the same loader while the outer insertion is still active.
The nested operation clears the shared state and releases objects still referenced by the outer operation.
The outer insertion resumes with those dangling references and dereferences freed storage, causing a use-after-free crash.
summary: Reentrant mutation invalidates borrowed insertion state
decision_reason: The failure is materially the same as re-entrant cleanup invalidating shared storage while the original operation continues using retained addresses, leading to use-after-free.
